<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The head of a section: an optional badge, the heading (h1 or h2) with an optional link opposite it, and an
  optional lead. No wrapper: its parts are children of the section stack.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { SectionHeading, HeadLink } from "./section-frame.types";

  export type SectionHeaderProps = {
    titleId: string;
    title?: string;
    heading?: SectionHeading;
    action?: HeadLink;
    lead?: string;
    center?: boolean;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../compose/Badge.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import Link from "../compose/Link.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let { titleId, title = "", heading, action, lead, center = false }: SectionHeaderProps = $props();
  const level = $derived(heading?.level ?? 2);
  const scale = $derived(heading?.scale ?? "default");
  const hasAction = $derived(action?.label && action?.href);
</script>

{#if heading?.badge}
  <Badge variant="outline" size="lg" class={(center ? "mx-auto w-fit" : "w-fit")} data-testid="section-badge">
    {heading?.badge}
  </Badge>
{/if}
{#if (((title as string) !== "") && hasAction)}
  <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between" class="w-full flex-wrap">
    <Title
      as={level}
      size={((level === 1) ? "5xl" : "xl")}
      weight="semibold"
      class={
        (scale as string) === "display" ? "text-6xl tracking-tight md:text-8xl"
        : level === 1 ? "leading-tight"
        : "leading-7"
      }
      id={titleId}
    >
      {title}
    </Title>
    <Link
      href={urlOf(action?.href)}
      variant="default"
      class={cn(defaults.text.tiny, "shrink-0 font-medium leading-5")}
      data-testid="section-action"
    >
      {action?.label}
    </Link>
  </Group>
{/if}
{#if (((title as string) !== "") && !hasAction)}
  <Title
    as={level}
    size={((level === 1) ? "5xl" : "xl")}
    weight="semibold"
    class={
      (scale as string) === "display" ? "text-6xl tracking-tight md:text-8xl"
      : level === 1 ? "leading-tight"
      : "leading-7"
    }
    id={titleId}
  >
    {title}
  </Title>
{/if}
{#if (((title as string) === "") && hasAction)}
  <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="end" class="w-full">
    <Link
      href={urlOf(action?.href)}
      variant="default"
      class={cn(defaults.text.tiny, "shrink-0 font-medium leading-5")}
      data-testid="section-action"
    >
      {action?.label}
    </Link>
  </Group>
{/if}
{#if lead}
  <Text size="base" class={cn("max-w-2xl text-muted-foreground", (center ? "mx-auto" : ""))}>
    {lead}
  </Text>
{/if}
